versions.changelog:
- Renamed skill from "openclaw" to "lyrashield"
- Added LICENSE file (MIT-0), specifying the new license
- Updated SKILL.md with version, license, and metadata (category, author, repository URL, required environment variable)
- Removed skill-card.md file
- Updated description to clarify community listing status and remove references to pending publisher verification

- Initial release of the LyraShield skill (openclaw) for reviewing release-assurance evidence via OAuth-first MCP connection.
- Enables read-only inspection of LyraShield dashboard evidence, summarizing issues and pending approvals.
- Skill operates as a community ClawHub listing; not yet an official OpenClaw channel.
- Writing actions require `lyrashield.write` OAuth scope and explicit approval.
